kind: six NEON GEMM vector intrinsic C bodies plus shared scalar min/max capability
input: two arbitrary binary32 values, including all NaNs, infinities, subnormals and signed zeros
precondition: emp; no finite-only or ordering restriction
postcondition: exact Coq fp32 value equality to GemmSpec.IntrinsicModel selected operation
rvv_nan_rule: one NaN returns the other operand; both NaN return canonical 0x7fc00000
zero_ties: min is negative zero if either zero is negative; max is negative zero only if both are negative
environment: LP64, little endian, binary32, round to nearest ties to even, no flush, no fast-math
helper_closure: actual qcp_minmax_identity body and fresh checked qcp_float_from_bits byte-copy body plus its callees
vector_contract_source: ../../experiments/gemm-qcp-do-reproducer/input/shim-undef.h; exact function signature and contract identity checked
remaining_intrinsic_gaps: GEMM FMA, NEON memory load/store, all RVV vector operations
